description: Figure 4 presents a bar chart illustrating a runtime comparison between the ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis lists the different models being compared, including “Joint Framework,” “Dual-LLM Framework,” and several unnamed LLM models, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 200 seconds, marked with tick labels at intervals of 50 seconds (0, 50, 100, 150, 200). Each bar corresponds to a model’s runtime, with the “Joint Framework” bar being the shortest at approximately 77 seconds, and the “Dual-LLM Framework” bar being the tallest at 172 seconds, explicitly labeled as “fastest.” The bars are colored in shades of gray, with no visual emphasis or annotation beyond their length and the “fastest” label on the Dual-LLM Framework bar. The chart visually demonstrates that the Dual-LLM Framework has the longest runtime while the Joint Framework has the shortest runtime among the models shown.
